name: Hakuou
source:
Hakuou wanders his hunting ground, the "Lost Forest", which is located right under the Sky World's gates. [spoiler] Sometime in the past, he ate the leader of a religious organisation known as the "Golden Bees". As a result, Hakuou was cursed. He became unable to eat humans, and lost his pride as a drone. Now he's currently searching for a way to lift the curse.

He seems to have some kind of involvement with Kaguya; the latter being currently contained by a surgeon. [/spoiler] There's nothing sinister about his liking of bondage- it's simply to his sexual tastes.

[Based on the tanslation of the official website profile.]
translation:
白凰在位于天空世界大门正下方的狩猎场“迷失之森”中徘徊。[spoiler]过去某个时候，他吃掉了名为“黄金蜜蜂”的宗教组织首领，因此受到诅咒。白凰无法再吃人，也失去了作为雄蜂的自尊。如今，他正在寻找解除诅咒的方法。

他似乎与辉夜有某种关系；后者目前被一名外科医生囚禁。[/spoiler]他喜欢束缚并没有什么阴暗原因，只是性癖如此。

[根据官方网站人物简介的译文整理。]
